name: Flightline
author: Pedro S. Oliveira
description: The whole world's air traffic on a GPU globe that follows your Omarchy theme: shaded relief, sea-floor depth, sunlight and trails. Counts the aircraft over your weather location, follows any flight with its route and ETA, and shows what is in your sky, Sun, Moon and planets included.

barWidget.description: Aircraft overhead in the bar; opens the live traffic globe

schema.label: Bar radius (nautical miles)
schema.description: The bar counts aircraft in the air within this distance of your location.

schema.label: Units
schema.description: auto follows your locale. aviation uses feet, knots and nautical miles.

schema.label: ADS-B source
schema.description: Free community feeds. The other one takes over automatically when the preferred one fails. adsb.fi only answers circles up to 250 NM, so the world view needs adsb.lol.

schema.label: Wide queries
schema.description: Lets the open panel ask adsb.lol for circles wider than its documented 250 NM, up to the whole world in one request. Turn off to keep every request within 250 NM.

schema.label: Relief and sea depth
schema.description: Shaded mountains, snow and ice, and the depth of the sea floor. Off draws the flat v2.0 globe.

schema.label: Aircraft trails
schema.description: A short fading tail behind every aircraft in the air, along its heading.

schema.label: Stars around the globe
schema.description: Faint, still stars around the Earth. Dark themes only.
